title: Create and tune water volumes
summary: Draw a water brush from an available appearance and edit its surface motion.
outcome: A complete water volume with chosen appearance and motion.

steps.title: Choose an appearance
steps.text: Choose Create → Water volume…. If prompted, load an asset library containing water appearances; select one in the picker.

steps.title: Draw the volume
steps.text: Drag in the top grid view. Set Base for the bottom and Depth for the water level above it, then inspect the brush in camera and side views.

steps.title: Complete an existing brush
steps.text: For a brush with a water face that is not yet a full volume, select it and choose Apply to entire brush in the Surfaces inspector.

sections.title: Adjust the surface

steps.title: Tune appearance
steps.text: Select the water volume, open Surfaces → Water, choose Change… for appearance, and adjust tint, Ripple strength, and Ripple speed.

steps.title: Author ocean motion
steps.text: Enable Ocean waves if needed, then set wave Height, Wavelength, Speed, and Direction. Choose Apply water to save these material settings.

tips: Ripple strength changes shading, not water geometry height. Short ocean wavelengths require more vertices.
Advanced → Reflection controls the minimum and maximum reflection and its falloff exponent. Use Revert to discard unapplied water field changes.
